Optimization & Learning

Reusable classical learning

Learning models that connect the studies

Developed reusable forecasting and molecular-classification APIs for grid benchmarking and ADMET.

  • scikit-learn
  • Time-series validation
  • Molecular learning
Main outcome

Reusable Python models with explicit data and evaluation contracts.

Motivation

Classical comparisons need reusable implementations with consistent fitting, evaluation and inference.

Implementation

Ridge, random forest, gradient boosting and echo-state reservoirs support the grid study. Full- and selected-count logistic classifiers support molecular ADMET learning. The extracted modules expose training, prediction, chronological or scaffold-separated evaluation, and portable molecular-model inference.

Results

The standalone forecasting run reproduces 324.3 MW test RMSE for gradient boosting on 2,823 targets. Molecular tests verify preprocessing, partition separation and portable inference; no ADMET predictive accuracy is claimed.

Limitations

Forecasting uses one historical geographic series. Molecular callers supply prepared features and scaffold keys; correct upstream preprocessing remains essential. These are the classical controls from the linked studies, packaged for independent reuse.
